scope: One fixed causal radar estimator study. Existing Urban01 fit/calibration are development data; no inference input from GNSS/OBD/reference labels. Prior studies remain immutable.
window_selection: The same three fixed 90s blocks at fractions .2,.5,.8 per role; no label/speed-based window replacement. New model warmup is explicitly reported.

features.source: latest good radar bag record at or before each grid time, no interpolation or future radar, history restricted to the current block
features.ready: Complete 6.35s block history; all 128 past grid entries and current endpoint valid. Unsupported endpoints are not silently discarded: count warmup/missing costs; compare methods on identical supported endpoints.

target: Previously decoded latest-prior horizontal offline reference speed; fit role only trains all estimators. The reference is a supervised label, not a live feature or proof of physical authenticity.
classical: Refit median uses identical causal signed-median raw feature as old predictor; speed-bin-balanced affine fit on fit labels. SG uses 51 trailing 20Hz signed grid samples, degree2 polynomial evaluated at newest sample (causal endpoint); absolute filtered raw speed followed by the same fit-only balanced affine calibration. No filter-parameter search.

candidate.architecture: 4-to-16 pointwise stem; five 16-channel causal kernel5 convolution blocks with dilations [1,2,4,8,16], ReLU and residual addition divided by sqrt(2); 16-to-1 endpoint head initialized to zero
candidate.output: reference-median-affine anchor plus learned correction; final speed clipped at zero
candidate.primary_prediction: Arithmetic mean of all three final-epoch seed predictions, never best-seed selection

cnn_reconstruction.architecture: six same-padded 1D kernel7 convolutions with channels [1,8,16,32,16,8,1], batchnorm and GELU(tanh approximation); input signed radar history; only final endpoint output used
cnn_reconstruction.output: 10 times final network output; speed clipped only for inference
cnn_reconstruction.training: Same fixed 80-epoch budget and three seeds, batch128, speed-bin-balanced endpoint MSE, RAdam lr0.001 weight_decay0.00001
cnn_reconstruction.fidelity: Inspired reconstruction only. Original code/checkpoints and complete width/stride/padding details were unavailable. This is not an exact reproduction of DOI10.1109/TIV.2023.3287790, nor its 400-epoch training, dataset split, sequence loss, median postfilter or positioning filter. Do not claim to outperform the published paper.

checkpoint_selection: Final epoch only. No early stopping, calibration-driven checkpoint choice, architecture sweep, seed selection or post-result retries.
normalization: Fixed scale constants above; no calibration/evaluation statistics are used. Label-bin weights are fit-only training weights, not an input context selected by attacked channels.

development_gate.applies_to: Every calibration block and calibration overall

prospective_evaluation.rule: May open only after this new estimator passes its development gate with model/implementation/parameter locks. This is a distinct protocol, not a bypass of the earlier failed cadence-policy protocol. Same accuracy/coverage/relative-RMSE gates apply, with no tuning afterward.

audit: Export weights as JSON and reproduce all predictions with NumPy independently of PyTorch. Standard project environment needs no new package for audit. Torch is for training only.
limits: Raw Doppler configured units/mounting angle and authenticated live clock/provenance remain unverified
Reference shares GNSS ancestry; offline supervision does not create a trusted online witness
Older opened Urban02 day/Urban03/Urban04 are not used to fit, choose checkpoints or claim fresh evaluation
One development recording and only 270s of fit blocks limit generalization
No neural policy promotion, vehicle control, GitHub push or manuscript
